title: Einstein's 1916 review of general relativity
summary: The 1916 Annalen paper is Einstein's systematic account of general relativity.
body: In 1916 Einstein published "Die Grundlage der allgemeinen Relativitätstheorie". It presents gravitation as spacetime curvature tied to mass and energy, rather than as a force in the Newtonian sense. That is the theory's own description. Whether particular predictions hold is a different question, answered by later observations such as the 1919 eclipse expedition and, much later, gravitational-wave detections.
